rules.title: A heading names its subject
rules.text: A question as a heading ('What does not work?') makes the reader ask it too. The subject named directly — 'What does not work' — is the same heading in fewer words and one less gesture.

judgement.question: Is this heading phrased as a question, where naming the subject would say the same thing in fewer words?

criteria.true: the heading asks a question that its own section then answers
criteria.false: the question is the document's own title, a quotation, or a heading whose subject genuinely is the open question
